title: Yellow Molten Italian Pasta Paccheri
description: A savory and romantic Italian dish featuring paccheri pasta in a sweet sherry sauce, perfect for a night in with loved ones. The dish is made with raw-friendly ingredients and a saute method to bring out the flavors.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the paccheri pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the diced onion and garlic until softened.
Add the diced yellow bell pepper to the skillet and continue to cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Pour in the sweet sherry and bring the mixture to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the shaved grana padano cheese until melted and smooth.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to coat with the sherry sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve immediately, with the molten cheese sauce still warm and bubbly.
